findings.problem: The one-request start path showed a generic transport error offline instead of the actionable connection-and-access hint used by the legacy path. The test was not started and its answers were not lost.
findings.fix: Retain NETWORK and remap its displayed message for both fast training and exam starts.
findings.verification: The existing access/intake UI suite reproduced the issue before the fix and passed all 11 checks after the fix.

findings.problem: The extracted real refresh function used the id helper, but its isolated VM omitted that helper. This produced an id-is-not-defined failure in the optional account-sync test; the application defines the helper.
findings.fix: Provide C.id in the VM and remove the unused paused-materials stub.

findings.problem: The default verification omitted the standalone account-sync/workspace-reliability models and the access/intake browser suite.
findings.fix: Require both model suites in npm test and the access/intake browser suite in verification and release workflows.

findings.problem: Headless Chromium on GitHub could lose the DevTools async evaluation promise while a large screen redraw was finishing, failing the responsive suite with Resulting promise was garbage collected. Keeping the returned promise globally was insufficient.
findings.fix: Start navigation without returning a promise to DevTools; poll an explicit done/error record, retaining navigation errors, a bounded wait, and all layout assertions.
findings.verification: All 271 responsive checks passed in pinned headless Chromium locally and on GitHub; all 11 access/intake browser checks and 11 packed-startup checks passed on GitHub as well.

checks: 27 separate Chromium sessions initialized with real server authentication
27 simultaneous 200-question submissions survive BUSY, 429, lost replies and restarts
All 27 large written submissions stay on disk during a total outage
Reopening all application windows preserves every offline answer
Restored connection commits 27 mixed works once, with pending manual grades
405 large written answers remain byte-for-byte identical in authoritative storage
Every saved queue is empty only after a server acknowledgement
No application exceptions, leaked cross-account requests or external traffic
